description: Fleet-shared Renovate baseline (agent-lcars#1340 C2), consumed as
`github>jlapenna/agent-lcars//renovate-preset` by every fleet repo that
runs Renovate at all -- hosted (this repo, homelab, sprinkles,
sync-padd) or self-hosted (supersprinklesracing/www,
supersprinklesracing/girosf, jlapenna/nx-cache-server,
jlapenna/repo-tools, run by .github/workflows/renovate-self-hosted.yml
since neither hosted app can be extended to them -- agent-lcars#2018).
See docs/renovate.md for the current, authoritative split; do not infer
it from this list, which is prose, not a contract. Carries only the
common core; genuinely repo-local policy stays in each consumer's own
renovate.json.
toolSettings.nodeMaxMemory (integer MiB, npm manager only) caps the Node
child processes Renovate spawns (pnpm lockfile/artifact updates), not
Renovate's own process. sprinkles' hosted job on 2026-09-15 used 3.0 GB
of Mend Community Cloud's 3.0 GB whole-job memory cap (11m of a 30m
execution limit); jobs that hit that cap are demoted to Mend's weekly
Blocked schedule until one clean run, consistent with sprinkles going
silent 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-15. The cap covers Renovate plus pnpm, so
this uses 1536, the bottom of Mend's recommended 1.5-2.5 GB range
(https://docs.renovatebot.com/mend-hosted/faq/).

packageRules.description: Group and automerge updates that preserve the declared compatibility range

Major updates always get a human look before merge, regardless of which bot authors the PR. This matters most for the self-hosted repos (agent-lcars#2018): their Renovate runs authenticate as agent-lcars[bot], which every member repo's agent-automerge-reusable.yml treats as an auto-mergeable bot login the moment a non-draft PR is opened -- labels added after PR creation are racy, but draft status set at creation is not, so draftPR is the actual guard and addLabels is a convenience for triage. This rule lives here, in the shared preset, rather than in renovate-self-hosted.json's global config: Renovate resolves a repository's own config (including everything it pulls in via `extends`, i.e. this preset) after global config and lets the later match win field-by-field, so only a preset-level (or repo-level) rule is guaranteed to survive -- a rule placed solely in the self-hosted global config could be silently overridden by a future repo-level packageRule. Putting it here means every consumer, hosted or self-hosted, gets it.
TypeScript 7 breaks Nx project-graph construction today. Hold only the 7.x line fleet-wide until Nx compatibility is proven, while leaving a later major available for its own review.

Images hosted only on LAN registries (docker-registry.lan.jlapenna.net, local/ tags) are unreachable from Renovate's hosted runner, so lookups fail as recurring 'Error obtaining docker token' repository problems. These pins are deliberate and updated by hand.

Match pnpm 11's own default 24-hour minimumReleaseAge install-time policy, for every pnpm 11 consumer. Without this, Renovate can open and auto-merge an npm bump for a package published hours ago, landing a lockfile entry that pnpm itself then rejects on the very next install (agent-lcars#1345/#1391). Consumers without npm packages are unaffected.
